name: Brevo
description: Transactional messaging, campaigns, contacts, CRM, conversations, commerce, events, and analytics through Brevo v3.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned API key and verified sender boundary, select capabilities, and let agents read, send, or use the full supported API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: BREVO_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Brevo API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-owned API key generated in Brevo SMTP & API settings.

credentialRequirements.name: BREVO_SENDER_BOUNDARY
credentialRequirements.label: Verified sender boundary
credentialRequirements.helpText: An exact registered sender email or authenticated domain.

capabilities.label: Account
capabilities.description: Read bounded account and plan metadata.

capabilities.label: Transactional email
capabilities.description: Send through the bound verified sender.

capabilities.label: Full Brevo v3 API
capabilities.description: Use every endpoint authorized by the customer API key.

allowed.label: Read account
allowed.description: Read bounded account and plan metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Send transactional email
approvalRequired.description: Sending requires approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Brevo API
approvalRequired.description: All other v3 operations require approval in Safe mode.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; sends and all other API operations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected API-key-authorized capability runs without Relay per-action approvals; ownership, sender binding, provider limits, secret isolation, evidence bounds, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Brevo tools and proxies the API key server-side.
Railway mounts selected Brevo tools and proxies the API key server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer generates an API key and enters it with an exact registered sender email or authenticated domain.

evidence.supports: Brevo OAuth exists but apps are currently private to users inside the app owner's Brevo organisation; public distribution is not yet supported.
Customers generate one-time-visible API keys and authenticate at the fixed v3 origin with the api-key header.
Transactional sends support 2,000 total recipients and message versions of at most 99 recipients, with registered senders/templates.
Brevo publishes endpoint-specific RPS/RPH limits and returns 429 when exceeded.
Responses expose x-sib rate-limit limit, remaining, and reset headers.
